name: AttachLinkFlags
meaning: AttachLink +7 as read by Instance_CalcWorldMatrix and written by Instance_DrawAnimParts

name: ATTACH_F_MATRIX_VALID
meaning: set when the parent's draw publishes the matrix; without it the child is marked invisible

name: ATTACH_F_PARENT_RENDERED
meaning: parent processed this frame: Scenaric_RenderAll clears 0x01|0x02 (& 0xFC) on every active link, then renders the parent of any link without 0x02; Scn_RenderIfVisible sets it (| 2) on its child links.

name: ATTACH_F_ROOT_ROTATION
meaning: publish the root part M[0] rotation with part M[partIndex] translation

name: ATTACH_F_LOCAL_OFFSET
meaning: child translation = link matrix applied to localOffset*8

name: ATTACH_F_EXTRA_ROTATION
meaning: multiply by RotXYZ(link rot) when publishing

name: ATTACH_F_WORLD_OFFSET
meaning: add worldOffset*8 to the child translation
